theorems.name: Submission.fiw_flat_cauchy_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), (∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∀ J : Set ℕ, J.Infinite → ∃ J' ⊆ J, J'.Infinite ∧ ∀ i ∈ J', ∀ j ∈ J', ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω, Tj i ω - Tj j ω = R.boundary ω + S ω) ∧ R.mass + S.mass < ε) → WeaklyConvergesOn Tj T → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω, Tj (φ ℓ) ω - T ω = R.boundary ω + S ω) ∧ R.mass + S.mass ≤ 2 * 2⁻¹ ^ ℓ
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
